address: via San Martino della Battaglia 16, La Spezia, 19121, Italy
bio: In the centre of Spezia, the restaurant unveils an impressive open kitchen, developing into a cosy room with vaulted brick ceilings in a more contemporary-styled setting. Similarly, the cuisine line reflects modern tones, with locally sourced fish at its finest expression, offering flexible options between tasting menus and à la carte choices, supported by a wine list of character....
